text: Data center revenue grew strongly as demand for accelerated computing and generative AI infrastructure remained robust. We are working closely with cloud service providers to scale deployment of our next generation GPU platform. Supply remains constrained in some components, and export regulations continue to create uncertainty in certain markets.

Our results depend on the continued adoption of accelerated computing, competition, supply availability, and our ability to execute a complex global supply chain. Customers are investing in AI factories, networking, and full-stack software.

Customer interest in our data center CPU and AI accelerator portfolio is increasing. We expect strong annual growth from server products, while PC demand remains mixed. Competition is intense and our ability to secure advanced packaging capacity is important to our roadmap.

We face risks from rapid product cycles, intense competition, manufacturing dependencies, export controls, and demand volatility. Our strategy focuses on high performance CPUs, GPUs, adaptive computing, and embedded markets.

AI networking and custom accelerator demand continued to accelerate. Our semiconductor solutions benefit from hyperscaler investment, but customer concentration and the timing of large infrastructure projects can create volatility.

We operate across networking, connectivity, storage, and custom silicon. Key risks include integration execution, supply constraints, geopolitical restrictions, customer concentration, and cyclicality in semiconductor markets.

Demand for leading-edge process technologies remains healthy, supported by AI and high performance computing. We are expanding capacity and advanced packaging. The global environment remains uncertain, including foreign exchange and geopolitical factors.

Our foundry model serves customers across high performance computing, smartphones, automotive, and IoT. We must manage capital intensity, technology development, energy availability, water supply, and geopolitical risk.

Demand for high bandwidth memory and data center products is strong. Tight industry supply and customer qualification cycles affect near-term revenue timing. We are increasing investment in advanced memory and packaging capacity.

Memory markets are highly cyclical and exposed to pricing pressure, inventory corrections, competition, and significant capital requirements. Our portfolio includes DRAM, NAND, high bandwidth memory, and solid state storage.

Bookings for advanced lithography systems reflect continued investment in leading-edge logic and memory. EUV productivity and customer capacity plans are important drivers. Export regulations and supply chain dependencies may affect shipments.

We provide lithography systems and services to semiconductor manufacturers. Our results depend on a small number of customers, complex supplier relationships, technology execution, export controls, and the semiconductor equipment cycle.
